question: outcome_summary
answer: The NLP/ML model performed well, achieving an AUC of 0.81 and a Brier score of 0.23, indicating good discrimination in identifying suicidal language. The integration of the MHSAFE interview process into the ED workflow enhanced the quality of information gathered from patients. The findings support the utility of language-based models in predicting suicide risk and suggest effective implementation in clinical settings. The model maintained performance across different geographic regions and time periods, despite variations in language due to external factors like the COVID-19 pandemic.

question: demographics_summary
answer: The study involved participants aged 18-65 who could provide informed consent and spoke English. There were 33 control participants and 37 case participants, totaling 70. The average age of control participants was 41.2 years, while the average age of case participants was 41.1 years. Gender distribution was similar across both groups, with 54.5% of control participants and 54.1% of case participants being male.
